mangas.title: Solo Leveling
mangas.author: Chugong
mangas.synopsis: E-rank hunter Jin-woo is the weakest. After a near-fatal dungeon encounter, a mysterious system offers him a second chance — to level up or die trying.

mangas.title: Chainsaw Man
mangas.author: Tatsuki Fujimoto
mangas.synopsis: Denji is a poor young man who becomes Chainsaw Man — a devil hunter with a chainsaw for a heart — and dives headfirst into a brutal war with devils.

mangas.title: One Piece
mangas.author: Eiichiro Oda
mangas.synopsis: Monkey D. Luffy sets sail to become the Pirate King, gathering a crew and facing the most fearsome oceans and enemies the world has to offer.

mangas.title: Jujutsu Kaisen
mangas.author: Gege Akutami
mangas.synopsis: Yuji Itadori swallows a cursed finger to save his friends, becoming the host of a terrifying curse and joining a school of jujutsu sorcerers.
